# Quickwit Provider

Manages [Quickwit](https://quickwit.io) indexes. Quickwit has no native authentication: use `headers` to authenticate against a reverse proxy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "quickwit" {
  endpoint = "http://localhost:7280"

  # Quickwit has no native authentication: authenticate against a proxy.
  # headers = { Authorization = "Bearer ${var.quickwit_token}" }

  timeout = "30s"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Quickwit REST endpoint, without the `/api/v1` suffix. Defaults to the `QUICKWIT_ENDPOINT` environment variable, then `http://localhost:7280`.
- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Extra HTTP headers sent with every request, e.g. `Authorization` for an authenticating proxy.
- `timeout` (String) HTTP request timeout, as a Go duration (`30s`, `2m`). Defaults to `30s`.
